description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to property of Intestate in the Village of Indibedda and other villages, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses on the registration and settlement of land titles for deceased persons' properties, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and title settlement procedures.
